runner.install_command: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3-pip && printf '[global]\nbreak-system-packages = true\n' > /etc/pip.conf && python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages --disable-pip-version-check 'flit_core>=3.12,<4' && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
runner.env_probe_command: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -c "import tomlparse, os; assert os.path.realpath(tomlparse.__file__).startswith(os.path.realpath('src')); d = tomlparse.loads('[player]\nname = \"probe\"\nnumber = 1'); assert d == {'player': {'name': 'probe', 'number': 1}}"

init_metadata.tech_stack: Pure Python TOML parser (flit_core src layout, zero runtime deps, stdlib unittest); CPU-only
